column2: Her truthful account of the accident matched exactly what the security camera had recorded.
column3: 她對事故的誠實說明，與監視器錄下的畫面完全吻合。
column5: truth 真話 + ful 充滿：滿口都是真話

column2: The senator's untruthful claims about the budget were exposed by a simple audit.
column3: 參議員關於預算的不實說法，被一次簡單的審計揭穿。
column5: un 不 + truthful 說真話：不說真話就是在騙人

column2: The avaricious landlord raised the rent again, though his tenants could barely pay.
column3: 貪財的房東又調漲租金，儘管房客幾乎付不起。
column5: 諧音「阿發-瑞-些」：阿發只想發財，錢永遠不嫌多

column2: As an impecunious student, he lived on instant noodles and borrowed textbooks.
column3: 身為窮學生，他靠泡麵和借來的課本過日子。
column5: im 無 + pecun 錢（拉丁 pecunia）：口袋裡沒有錢

column2: The clinic offers free care to indigent families who cannot afford a doctor.
column3: 這間診所為付不起醫藥費的貧困家庭提供免費看診。
column5: in 地 gent：紳士 gent 窮到只能坐在地上

column2: The affluent suburb has tree-lined streets, private pools, and three-car garages.
column3: 這個富裕的郊區有林蔭街道、私人泳池和三車車庫。
column5: af 向 + flu 流（fluid 流體）：財富像水流向你

column2: The hotel lobby was opulent, with gold ceilings and crystal chandeliers.
column3: 這間飯店的大廳極其奢華，有金色天花板和水晶吊燈。
column5: 想像金碧輝煌的歌劇院 opera，連開頭 op 都閃閃發光

column2: The fractious committee argued over every comma and refused to approve the agenda.
column3: 這個難以管束的委員會連每個逗號都要爭論，拒絕通過議程。
column5: fract 斷裂（fraction 分數）：愛吵架，氣氛一直被撕裂

column2: The irascible old chef slammed his ladle down whenever an order came out late.
column3: 只要出菜太慢，脾氣暴躁的老廚師就會重重放下湯勺。
column5: ira 是拉丁文「怒」（ire 憤怒）+ ible 容易：容易發火

column2: The peevish toddler whined about the soup, the spoon, and even the color of his cup.
column3: 愛抱怨的幼兒嫌湯、嫌湯匙，連杯子的顏色也要嫌。
column5: 諧音「皮微什」：皮皮地嘟著嘴，什麼都嫌

column2: The crowd grew restive as the concert started an hour late.
column3: 演唱會晚了一小時才開始，群眾漸漸焦躁不安。
column5: 長得像 rest 休息，但意思相反：坐不住、想站起來
column8: 焦躁不安；倔強不服管束

column2: The skittish horse bolted at the sudden clap of thunder.
column3: 這匹易受驚的馬被突然的雷聲嚇得狂奔而去。
column5: skit 像 skate 滑走：一嚇就溜，像受驚的小貓

column2: Despite its size, the elephant was docile and let the children feed it.
column3: 這頭大象雖然體型龐大，卻很溫馴，讓孩子們餵牠。
column5: doc 教導（doctor 醫生、doctrine 教義）：好教、聽話

column2: A complaisant assistant, he agreed to every change the director proposed.
column3: 他是個一味迎合的助理，導演提出的每項更動他都點頭。
column5: com 一起 + plais 愉悅（please）：為了讓人高興而順從

column2: Looking contrite, the boy handed back the broken vase and apologized.
column3: 男孩一臉懊悔地交出破掉的花瓶並道歉。
column5: con 完全 + trit 磨碎：心被磨碎般難過，才會悔悟

column2: The penitent thief returned the stolen bicycle and asked its owner for forgiveness.
column3: 悔過的小偷歸還偷來的腳踏車，並請求車主原諒。
column5: pen 像 penalty 處罰：受罰之後真心後悔

column2: Impenitent to the end, the tyrant never admitted a single mistake.
column3: 暴君至死不悔，從不承認自己犯過任何錯。
column5: im 不 + penitent 悔過：做錯了還昂著頭

column2: The obdurate mayor ignored every petition and refused to reopen the bridge.
column3: 頑固的市長無視所有請願，拒絕重新開放那座橋。
column5: ob 對抗 + dur 硬（durable 耐用）：硬得像石頭，說不動

column2: An inveterate gambler, he returned to the casino every weekend despite his losses.
column3: 他是積習難改的賭客，儘管不停輸錢，每個週末仍回賭場。
column5: in 在裡面 + vet 老（veteran 老兵）：老習慣深深紮根

column2: The vestigial wings of the flightless beetle no longer serve any purpose.
column3: 這種不會飛的甲蟲已退化的翅膀，不再有任何用途。
column5: vestige 是「腳印」：只剩一點痕跡，像淡淡的腳印

column2: He abjured violence and spent the rest of his life teaching peaceful negotiation.
column3: 他發誓棄絕暴力，餘生都在教導和平談判。
column5: ab 離開 + jur 發誓（jury 陪審團）：發誓要離開

column2: Monks abnegate personal comfort so they can devote themselves fully to prayer.
column3: 僧侶摒棄個人的安逸，好讓自己全心投入祈禱。
column4: abnegate one's rights (放棄自身權利)
column5: ab 離開 + neg 否定（negative）：否定自己、放下慾望
column8: 放棄權利；克己；自我犧牲

column2: The accountant absconded with the funds and was never seen in town again.
column3: 會計捲款潛逃，此後再也沒有人在鎮上見過他。
column5: ab 離開 + scond 藏：偷偷躲起來溜走

column2: Her acerbic review called the film "two hours of beautifully photographed boredom."
column3: 她尖酸的影評把這部電影形容為「兩小時拍得很美的無聊」。
column5: acer 酸、尖（acid 酸）：說話像檸檬汁，又酸又刺

column2: An adroit negotiator, she steered the tense talks toward a quick compromise.
column3: 她是個靈巧的談判高手，把緊繃的會談引向迅速的妥協。
column5: 法文 à droit 是「向右」，古人認為右手最靈巧

column2: The dexterous pianist's fingers flew across the keys without a single slip.
column3: 這位靈巧的鋼琴家手指在琴鍵上飛舞，一個失誤也沒有。
column5: dexter 拉丁文「右手」：右手靈活，手腳俐落

column2: Some vendors adulterate honey with cheap syrup to increase their profit.
column3: 有些攤販在蜂蜜裡摻入廉價糖漿以增加利潤。
column5: a + dull 鈍：純的東西被摻雜，味道變鈍變差

column2: She accepted the invitation with alacrity and was packed within the hour.
column3: 她欣然接受邀請，一小時內就收拾好行李。
column5: 諧音「阿拉快力提」：好事來了，馬上快快去做

column2: The two small banks amalgamated to form a single regional lender.
column3: 兩家小銀行合併，成為一家區域性的放款機構。
column5: amalgam 是補牙的汞合金：把金屬混成一體

column2: New drainage ameliorated conditions in the flooded neighborhood within a year.
column3: 新的排水系統在一年內改善了淹水社區的狀況。
column5: melior 是拉丁文「更好」：讓情況變得更好

column2: A horse-drawn plow looked anachronistic beside the gleaming wind turbines.
column3: 馬拉的犁在閃亮的風力發電機旁，顯得不合時代。
column5: ana 錯 + chron 時間（chronology 年表）：時間放錯位置

column2: Compromise was anathema to the senator, who treated every concession as defeat.
column3: 妥協對那位參議員而言深惡痛絕，他把每次讓步都視為失敗。
column4: be anathema to (為…所深惡痛絕)
column5: 諧音「啊那是媽」：一看到就喊「啊！快拿走！」
column8: 極度令人厭惡的人事物；詛咒

column2: Years of rivalry had left a lasting animus between the two families.
column3: 多年的對立在兩個家族之間留下了持久的敵意。
column5: anim 是心、靈魂（animal 動物）：心裡藏著恨意

column2: Animosity between the neighboring villages dated back to a quarrel over a well.
column3: 鄰近兩村之間的敵意，可追溯到一場為了水井的爭吵。
column4: animosity toward rivals (對對手的敵意)
column5: animus 敵意 + osity 充滿：滿腔敵意，像齜牙的動物 animal

column2: The office still relied on antiquated typewriters that jammed every few minutes.
column3: 這間辦公室仍倚賴每隔幾分鐘就卡住的老舊打字機。
column5: antique 是古董：像古董一樣老舊過時

column2: Her cautious philosophy is antithetical to his love of risk and improvisation.
column3: 她謹慎的處世哲學，與他熱愛冒險和即興正好相反。
column5: anti 反 + thesis 論點：兩個論點針鋒相對

column2: Voters grew apathetic after years of broken promises and stopped going to the polls.
column3: 多年跳票之後，選民變得冷漠，不再前往投票。
column5: a 無 + path 感受（sympathy 同情）：一點感覺都沒有

column2: The young violinist handled the broken string with remarkable aplomb and kept playing.
column3: 年輕的小提琴家以驚人的沉著處理斷弦，並繼續演奏。
column5: 諧音「阿，不慌」：弦斷了還是不慌不忙

column2: As a tireless apologist for free trade, she defended it in every interview.
column3: 身為自由貿易不知疲倦的辯護者，她在每次訪談中都為它說話。
column4: apologist for the regime (政權的辯護者)
column5: apolog 辯護（apology 原指辯解）+ ist 人
column8: 辯護者；為某主義辯護的人

column2: The council's approbation came quickly, and work on the library began the following spring.
column3: 市議會很快就表示認可，圖書館隔年春天便動工了。
column4: win official approbation (獲得正式認可)
column5: approve 贊成的名詞版：官方蓋章說「好」
